## Personality

Maria is characterized by a habit of laughing constantly. This behavior was particularly noted when she laughed in response to a simple remark about the weather.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P6](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0006)_

## History

Maria lived at Patty's Place with Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and had an uncle named [Aaron](../character/aaron.md) who was good to her. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visited to inquire about renting the house, Maria and Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) agreed to lease it to them so that the two women could fulfill their goal of traveling to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). They subsequently vacated the house, allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends to move in for their sophomore year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P3](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0003), [v3 ch.Place P4](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0004), [v3 ch.Place P5](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0005), [v3 ch.Place P6](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0006), [v3 ch.Place P7](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0007), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), +68 more_

## Relationships

### [Patty](../character/patty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--patty.md)

Miss Maria and Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford are co-owners of Patty's Place who become traveling companions. After [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) demonstrates a sincere appreciation for their house, Maria and [Patty](../character/patty.md) agree to rent the property to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends so that the two women can embark on a trip to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) together.

- Comrade of — traveling companions abroad  <sub>[v3 ch.Confidences P8](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0008), [v3 ch.Dawn P2](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0002)</sub>
